title: What could keep a treasure safe on a number row?
description: A treasure chest is placed on one number of a long row, and a jumper tries to land on it with equal steps. The video ends on the open question of which special numbers could keep the treasure safe.
teaching_notes: One idea: some numbers can be reached by equal jumps and some cannot, and special numbers decide which. Ask children to guess and do not confirm any guess, because the later topics settle it.

video_script.why: Before any word of multiples, factors or primes, the child wonders which special numbers could keep a treasure safe from a jumper.
video_script.substitution: Picture a treasure chest placed on a number, and a jumper who tries to reach it with equal steps.
video_script.anchor: the treasure chest that Jia places on a number, and Ziva who jumps along the number row

names.Jia: places the treasures on numbers in the treasure game

hold_back: the numbers that keep the treasure safe

maths_rules: The number row is drawn with unmarked stepping marks, so no number is written anywhere.
The chest sits on one mark and the jumper starts at the first mark, zero.
The open question, which special numbers keep the treasure safe, is never answered.
video_script.design: One idea: a treasure placed on a number may or may not be reached by equal jumps. Assumes nothing. No wrong idea is broken. The row, the chest and the two players arrive one by one and all stay to the end.
